meaning: 在大厅举行而非在场地
usageNote: 描述活动换地点！instead of是重点，表示'用A替换B'，日常超实用～

examples.en: The ceremony will take place in the hall instead of the field due to rain.
examples.zh: 由于下雨，典礼将在大厅举行而非在操场上。

examples.en: The concert took place in the hall instead of the field because of bad weather.
examples.zh: 因为天气恶劣，音乐会在大厅举行而非在露天场地。
